note: Shrink-only ratchet for ci:outbound-tracking. Each entry is a registered template that fails the link or pixel check today. reasons must match the gate exactly. A new reason fails. A reason that no longer reproduces fails until the entry is removed. Do not add a row to hide a new template. There is no --write flag.

cma-legacy-contact.note: sendLegacyCmaDelivery attributes the letter, then prepareDeliverableEmail appends the unsubscribe footer. The instrumenter leaves that unsubscribe href raw. Content links and the open pixel pass.

market-report-cadence.note: Content links are wrapped and the open pixel is present. The one raw href is the unsubscribe URL: attributeOutbound decorates it, then leaves it unwrapped because it is an unsubscribe link. sendOneSubscriber in lib/crm/market-report-send.ts (the attributeOutbound call near lines 159-165) does not pass broker, so opens and clicks are not stamped with the broker. This gate checks links and the pixel only and does not assert that stamp.

newsletter-market-report-bulk.note: The market section links are wrapped and the open pixel is present. The newsletter unsubscribe href is left raw.

newsletter-drain.note: renderForRecipient wraps content links and adds the open pixel. The newsletter unsubscribe href is left raw.

newsletter-one-click.note: instrumentEmailHtml wraps content links and adds the open pixel. The newsletter unsubscribe href is left raw.

listing-alert-cron.note: Listing links are wrapped and the open pixel is present. The alerts unsubscribe href is left raw.

listing-alert-send-now.note: attributeOutbound runs, then prepareDeliverableEmail. Listing links and the open pixel pass. The alerts unsubscribe href is left raw.

email-cohort.note: sendOneCohortEmail attributes the body, then prepareDeliverableEmail appends the unsubscribe footer. That unsubscribe href stays raw. Content links and the open pixel pass.

governed-resend.note: sendViaResend prepares (unsubscribe footer) and then the shared send path instruments. The unsubscribe href is decorated and left unwrapped. The content link and the open pixel pass.

signing-invite.note: The signing CTA points at /sign/, which the instrumenter treats as a private link and does not wrap. The open pixel is present. The shell has one href, asserted statically.
